summary: Completed backend and frontend regression testing for monitoring, native API boundaries, router drawer, filtering, backups, schedules, and responsive navigation.

integration_issues.issue: Open WebFig console only shows a local toast and does not open a native RouterOS configuration experience; actual RouterOS execution is MOCKED/configuration-gated.

issues: Browser console reports transient Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings during initial render; chart recovers visually.

action_items: Replace or rename the WebFig console placeholder and wire it to the intended native RouterOS configuration flow when credentials are configured.
Guard ResponsiveContainer until its parent has non-zero dimensions to remove initial chart warnings.
Implement the promised binary/text backup transfer, encryption, history persistence, scheduling worker, and SMTP attachments before claiming backup execution is live.
critical_code_review_comments: backup_history returns every stored history field except _id; sanitize server-side if future records contain paths, SMTP metadata, or other secrets.
The monitoring overview is static demo data and direct RouterOS reads/writes, backup transfer, and SMTP delivery are MOCKED/configuration-gated; keep this status explicit in production UI copy.
Management endpoints have no authentication or tenant/RBAC enforcement yet, so do not expose them outside a trusted network until auth is implemented.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing demo overview rows. No managed router or credentials were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Health, overview, allow-list validation, safe credential failure, backup history/schedule validation, search/group filtering, drawer tabs, direct API error feedback, Backup Now missing-inventory feedback, Settings styling, and mobile sidebar passed. Live RouterOS, binary/text backup, SMTP, authentication/RBAC, and schedule execution remain untested and MOCKED/configuration-gated.
rca of the issue: The console action is implemented as setNotice(...) only, while the button is labeled Open WebFig console. Recharts mounts before its responsive container is measured, causing transient negative dimensions. The backend intentionally returns demo monitoring data and configuration-required/managed-inventory errors because no live router, encryption, or SMTP settings exist.
